verdict.rationale: Thoropass's own marketing says it connects evidence, progress and auditors in one platform from kickoff to final report. Its docs describe audits with evidence requests and a centralized comments inbox for Controls and Evidence Requests that replaces lost email threads. The core idea of auditors working in-platform is claimed, but no specific auditor-facing view is documented. missing for 10: documented auditor role or scoped auditor view of controls and evidence, details of auditor permissions or access scoping, independent or hands-on corroboration of auditor in-platform workflow.

support.subject: As a founder, my auditor works directly in the platform — a scoped auditor view of controls and evidence replaces email threads of PDFs

citations.quote: Thoropass connects evidence, progress, and auditors in one place from kickoff to final report.
From scoping through final report, every step happens in one platform, so you spend less time managing the audit and more time strengthening your security program.
The new feature keeps all communication across Thoropass in one page, making managing Controls and Evidence Requests easier and faster.
Instead of losing track of emails or using messy spreadsheets, you can use filters and search tools to quickly find what you need and jump to the right task.
First Pass AI pre-screens evidence before the audit, eliminating the bottlenecks between evidence collection and auditor acceptance
